module: World editor extension that provides the "Edit MeshRoad" mode (mesh roads). It loads editor/meshEditor.lua with dofile(), sets type = "MeshRoad", preferencesName = "meshRoadEditor" and niceName = "Mesh Road" on it, then registers the meshRoadEditMode edit mode (action map MeshRoadEditor, icon create_road_mesh). Alt+left click creates a road or adds a node; copy/paste transfers the properties.
notes: All the logic is in meshEditor.lua; this file only configures it and relays its hooks.

Bug: M.onEditorGui, M.deleteNodeAM and M.selectAllNodes are assigned from meshEditor.onEditorGui_, .deleteNodeAM and .selectAllNodes, which do not exist in meshEditor.lua: these three fields are nil. Deletion and select-all actually go through the edit mode's onDeleteSelection and onSelectAll.

onEditorGui.desc: Meant to relay meshEditor.onEditorGui_, but this function does not exist: it is nil.

deleteNodeAM.desc: Relay of meshEditor.deleteNodeAM, which does not exist: it is nil.

selectAllNodes.desc: Relay of meshEditor.selectAllNodes, which does not exist: it is nil.

onEditorInspectorHeaderGui.desc: Relay of meshEditor.onEditorInspectorHeaderGui_ (nodes panel in the inspector).

onEditorInspectorFieldChanged.desc: Relay of meshEditor.onEditorInspectorFieldChanged_ (regenerates the road if segmentLength or subdivideLength changes).

onEditorInitialized.desc: Hook called at world editor initialization: creates editor.editModes.meshRoadEditMode (name "Edit MeshRoad", onActivate, onUpdate, onToolbar, onDeselect, copy/paste, deletion, select all) and its auxiliary shortcuts (Alt+LMB, copy, paste).

onExtensionLoaded.desc: Hook called when the extension loads: writes "initialized" to the log (level D).
